parameters.jsCode: const cb=$json.callback_query; const msg=$json.message; const from=cb?.from||msg?.from||{}; const data=String(cb?.data||''); const text=String(msg?.text||msg?.caption||'').trim(); const photos=Array.isArray(msg?.photo)?msg.photo:[]; const photo_file_id=photos.length?String(photos[photos.length-1].file_id||''):''; const isStart=/^\/start(?:@[A-Za-z0-9_]+)?(?:\s+.*)?$/.test(text); let action='UNKNOWN'; if(data==='role:man') action='ROLE_MAN'; else if(data==='role:woman') action='ROLE_WOMAN'; else if(data==='man_name:keep') action='MAN_NAME_KEEP'; else if(data==='man_name:change') action='MAN_NAME_CHANGE'; else if(data==='man_catalog:open') action='MAN_CATALOG'; else if(data==='man_preferences:open') action='MAN_PREFERENCES'; else if(data) action='UNKNOWN_CALLBACK'; else if(isStart) action='START'; else if(photo_file_id) action='PHOTO'; else if(text.startsWith('/')) action='UNKNOWN_COMMAND'; else if(text) action='TEXT'; return [{json:{telegram_id:String(from.id||''),telegram_first_name:String(from.first_name||'').trim(),username:String(from.username||''),chat_id:String(cb?.message?.chat?.id||msg?.chat?.id||from.id||''),callback_query_id:String(cb?.id||''),message_id:String(msg?.message_id||cb?.message?.message_id||''),action,text,photo_file_id}}];

parameters.query:
WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT (data->>'user_id')::uuid user_id,data->>'action' action,NULLIF(btrim(data->>'first_name'),'') first_name,NULLIF(btrim(data->>'answer'),'') answer FROM bind),
user_guard AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(input.user_id::text)) FROM input),
user_before AS (SELECT u.id,u.role FROM users u CROSS JOIN input CROSS JOIN user_guard WHERE u.id=input.user_id),
requested AS (SELECT input.*,CASE input.action WHEN 'ROLE_MAN' THEN 'man' WHEN 'ROLE_WOMAN' THEN 'woman' END requested_role FROM input),
role_update AS (
 UPDATE users u SET role=requested.requested_role,updated_at=now() FROM requested,user_before WHERE u.id=user_before.id AND user_before.role IS NULL AND requested.requested_role IS NOT NULL RETURNING u.id,u.role
),
effective_user AS (
 SELECT id,role FROM role_update UNION ALL SELECT id,role FROM user_before WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM role_update)
),
decision AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN requested.requested_role IS NULL THEN 'NO_ROLE_EVENT' WHEN user_before.role IS NULL THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN lower(user_before.role)=requested.requested_role THEN 'IDEMPOTENT' ELSE 'REJECTED' END role_decision
 FROM requested,user_before
),
man_seed AS (
 INSERT INTO male_search_context(user_id,name,onboarding_state)
 SELECT effective_user.id,requested.first_name,CASE WHEN requested.first_name IS NULL THEN 'AWAITING_MANUAL_NAME' ELSE 'AWAITING_NAME_CONFIRMATION' END
 FROM effective_user,requested,decision WHERE lower(effective_user.role)='man' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED'
 ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id
),
man_change AS (
 UPDATE male_search_context c SET onboarding_state='AWAITING_MANUAL_NAME',name_source=NULL,name_confirmed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
 FROM requested,effective_user,decision WHERE c.user_id=effective_user.id AND lower(effective_user.role)='man' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action='MAN_NAME_CHANGE' AND c.onboarding_state IN ('AWAITING_NAME_CONFIRMATION','AWAITING_CITY') RETURNING c.user_id
),
man_keep AS (
 UPDATE male_search_context c SET name_source='TELEGRAM_CONFIRMED',name_confirmed_at=now(),onboarding_state='AWAITING_CITY',updated_at=now()
 FROM requested,effective_user,decision WHERE c.user_id=effective_user.id AND lower(effective_user.role)='man' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action='MAN_NAME_KEEP' AND c.onboarding_state='AWAITING_NAME_CONFIRMATION' AND c.name IS NOT NULL RETURNING c.user_id
),
manual_name AS (
 UPDATE male_search_context c SET name=requested.answer,name_source='MANUAL',name_confirmed_at=now(),onboarding_state='AWAITING_CITY',updated_at=now()
 FROM requested,effective_user,decision WHERE c.user_id=effective_user.id AND lower(effective_user.role)='man' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action='TEXT' AND requested.answer IS NOT NULL AND c.onboarding_state='AWAITING_MANUAL_NAME' RETURNING c.user_id
),
city_update AS (
 UPDATE male_search_context c SET city=requested.answer,city_normalized=normalize_city_name(requested.answer),onboarding_state='COMPLETED',updated_at=now()
 FROM requested,effective_user,decision WHERE c.user_id=effective_user.id AND lower(effective_user.role)='man' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action='TEXT' AND requested.answer IS NOT NULL AND c.onboarding_state='AWAITING_CITY' RETURNING c.user_id
),
existing_woman_profile AS (
 SELECT p.id,p.user_id FROM profiles p,effective_user WHERE p.user_id=effective_user.id AND p.status='DRAFT' ORDER BY p.created_at,p.id LIMIT 1
),
woman_profile AS (
 INSERT INTO profiles(user_id,status)
 SELECT effective_user.id,'DRAFT' FROM effective_user,requested,decision WHERE lower(effective_user.role)='woman' AND decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action IN ('ROLE_WOMAN','START','TEXT','PHOTO') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id=effective_user.id)
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id,user_id
),
profile_choice AS (SELECT id,user_id FROM woman_profile UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id FROM existing_woman_profile WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM woman_profile)),
woman_session AS (
 INSERT INTO profile_ai_sessions(user_id,profile_id,current_step,ai_context,status)
 SELECT profile_choice.user_id,profile_choice.id,0,'{}'::jsonb,'IN_PROGRESS' FROM profile_choice,requested,decision WHERE decision.role_decision<>'REJECTED' AND requested.action IN ('ROLE_WOMAN','START','TEXT','PHOTO') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profile_ai_sessions s WHERE s.user_id=profile_choice.user_id AND s.status='IN_PROGRESS')
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id,user_id,profile_id
),
session_choice AS (
 SELECT id,user_id,profile_id FROM woman_session UNION ALL SELECT s.id,s.user_id,s.profile_id FROM profile_ai_sessions s JOIN profile_choice p ON p.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM woman_session) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
)
SELECT effective_user.id::text user_id,requested.action,decision.role_decision,effective_user.role,(SELECT id::text FROM profile_choice LIMIT 1) woman_profile_id,(SELECT id::text FROM session_choice LIMIT 1) woman_session_id
FROM effective_user,requested,decision;

WITH bind AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),
input AS (SELECT (data->>'user_id')::uuid user_id,data->>'action' action,data->>'role_decision' role_decision FROM bind)
SELECT u.id::text user_id,u.role,c.name,c.name_source,c.name_confirmed_at,c.city,c.city_normalized,c.onboarding_state,input.action,input.role_decision,ws.session_id::text woman_session_id,ws.profile_id::text woman_profile_id,ws.current_step woman_current_step,ws.profile_status woman_profile_status,ws.session_status woman_session_status,CASE WHEN ws.profile_status='ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN ws.profile_status='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN ws.profile_status='PENDING_MODERATION' OR ws.session_status='COMPLETED' THEN 'PENDING_MODERATION' WHEN ws.profile_status='DRAFT' AND ws.session_status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN ws.profile_status='DRAFT' THEN 'DRAFT_WITHOUT_SESSION' END woman_state
FROM input JOIN users u ON u.id=input.user_id
LEFT JOIN male_search_context c ON c.user_id=u.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.id profile_id,p.status profile_status,s.id session_id,s.current_step,s.status session_status FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.id,x.current_step,x.status,x.created_at FROM profile_ai_sessions x WHERE x.user_id=u.id AND x.profile_id=p.id ORDER BY CASE x.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 0 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,x.created_at DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE p.user_id=u.id ORDER BY CASE p.status WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 0 WHEN 'PENDING_MODERATION' THEN 1 WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 2 WHEN 'BLOCKED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT 1) ws ON true;
